prompt: Cinematic identity portrait, 9:16 vertical composition, medium half-body shot, static, even soft frontal-to-slightly-angled lighting. A realistic East Asian Chinese woman, about 30 to 35 years old, mature and quietly reserved with a story behind her eyes, calm restrained expression. Shoulder-length dark brown hair worn loose. She wears simple everyday home clothes: a soft oatmeal-beige long-sleeve knit top, relaxed and unbranded. Bright, evenly lit neutral-warm home interior background, gentle diffuse daylight, ceiling light on, no single dim yellow lamp, no moody shadows. Matte skin with realistic pores, fine skin texture and natural film grain, shot on an iPhone with true-to-life handheld realism; no oily facial glare, no highlight reflection on the face, no plastic AI sheen, no beauty-retouch fake skin, no wax texture. She is Chinese with an East Asian face, not a western face. Natural neutral-warm color, shallow depth of field. No text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark, no brand anywhere.
prompt_zh: 电影感身份母板，9:16竖屏构图，中景半身，静态，正面到微侧的均匀柔光。真实东亚中国女性，30-35岁，成熟隐忍、眼神有故事，神情平静克制。中长深棕发披肩。家常便装：柔和燕麦米色长袖针织上衣，无品牌。背景为明亮通透、光线均匀的中性偏暖白居家室内，柔和漫射日光、顶灯开，不用单盏暗黄灯、无压抑阴影。哑光肤质有真实毛孔与细节、自然颗粒，iPhone真实手持质感；无脸部油光、无高光反光、无塑料AI感、无磨皮假脸、无蜡感。中国东亚脸，非欧美脸。中性偏暖自然色，浅景深。任何位置无文字/字幕/logo/水印/品牌。
